summary.headline: Saturn’s Astrological Significations
summary.text: Saturn’s astrological significations, including poverty, exile, bodily parts, cold-related diseases, deaths by water or hanging, storms, crop destruction, and foul weather. Its conjunction with Jupiter brings generosity, administration, stewardship, and entrusted possessions when both are well placed.
